D-001.rationale: R04 guarantees the reserved interval, while R05 explicitly allows a conflicting walk-in loan. The finding identifies the missing priority decision.

D-002.rationale: R07 requires inspection state and prohibits reissue for damage, whereas R08 makes every returned unit available. These are incompatible outcomes for the same return.

D-003.rationale: R12 requires the initial procurement cost of the particular unit but does not supply a source for it. Although classified as conflict by the report, the identified corrective decision is the labeled missing cost data source.

D-004.rationale: R06 leaves both end-of-business-day time and the applicable calendar undefined, so the finding correctly identifies the ambiguous overdue transition.

D-005.rationale: R11 needs a mapping from scanned pass UID to internal employee ID but the specified staff directory has no pass data; the finding identifies the missing mapping.

D-006.rationale: R10 does not define how far in advance the reminder is to be delivered; the report identifies the same missing measurable timing criterion.

D-007.rationale: R05 gives a maximum in calendar days while R06 ties the deadline to the final day. The specification does not define how the issuance date is counted for a partial first day, so the latest permitted return date can differ. This date calculation is distinct from which clock time and work calendar define the end of that date (D02).
